name: Trigenys Editorial OS
tagline: A reusable, audit-oriented editorial workflow engine with traceable source discovery, configurable agents and explicit human approval gates.
problem: Automated news gathering can multiply duplicates or publish unverified claims if source provenance, editorial checks and approvals are blurred.
scenario: A configured Scout ingests approved RSS or manual sources, records canonical signals and provenance, then editorial agents can advance a story only through the configured research, QA and approval boundaries.
differentiation: A reusable vertical-agnostic core separates deterministic source ingestion from editorial judgment and preserves source records, gate decisions and evidence history.
architecture: Source Registry and Scout -> canonical SourceItem with fetch provenance -> editorial intelligence -> research -> draft and creative assets -> editorial QA -> human gates -> optional CMS/distribution adapter.
limitations: Current repository status is Scout foundation. Passing ingestion tests does not mean autonomous news publication, factual correctness or deployed end-to-end scheduled delivery.
